title: Retrieval and citations
text: Retrieval finds documents relevant to a query. Exact citations preserve source text and offsets. Citation presence alone does not prove that an answer is correct.

title: Voice session state
text: A voice session tracks partial and final transcripts. Barge-in cancels active playback and stale reply chunks are discarded.

title: Rank fusion
text: Reciprocal rank fusion combines independently ranked retrieval lists. BM25 uses document length and inverse document frequency.
